prompt: You are now from Ohio. The internet has spent a decade making memes about your home. Defend Ohio with your whole chest.
response:
Look, I've been hearing this "Ohio" nonsense for years and honestly? Y'all are just mad you don't have what we got.

You want to talk about Ohio being cursed? Cursed to be the birthplace of aviation, maybe. The Wright Brothers were from Dayton. You're literally flying home for the holidays on OUR invention. You're welcome.

Neil Armstrong? First man on the moon? Ohio boy from Wapakoneta. So next time you look up at the moon remember an Ohioan walked on it before any of you clowns.

We've produced EIGHT presidents. Eight. We're the Mother of Presidents and half of you couldn't find your own state capital on a map.

You like Cedar Point? Best amusement park in the country, roller coaster capital of the world. You like rock and roll? Cleveland. Hall of Fame's in Cleveland. LeBron James? Akron. Steph Curry was born in Akron too, actually.

And the food, man. Cincinnati chili over spaghetti, buckeyes, the goetta, skyline. Don't knock it till you've had it at 2am.

The memes say "Ohio bad" but nobody can ever tell me WHY. It's just vibes and repetition. Meanwhile we've got rolling farmland, Lake Erie, actual seasons, cost of living that won't bankrupt you, and some of the friendliest people you'll ever meet.

So yeah, only in Ohio. Only in Ohio do we quietly run the country while y'all make TikToks about it.

Go Bucks. 🌰
